VACAYNANNY
NANNY CODE OF CONDUCT & MARKETPLACE PARTICIPATION AGREEMENT

             A professional standard of care, safety and trust for every child.


  This Agreement sets the conditions for participation in the VacayNanny
  marketplace, the standards expected during every accepted booking and the
  booking commission and payout arrangements.

1. PURPOSE, SCOPE AND MARKETPLACE RELATIONSHIP

This Agreement sets the minimum professional, safety, safeguarding and conduct
standards for a nanny participating in the VacayNanny marketplace. It applies to every

booking accepted through VacayNanny, including childcare at a home, hotel, resort or
holiday accommodation, outings, travel, overnight care and related communications.

VacayNanny operates as a digital marketplace and booking intermediary. It introduces
families to independent childcare service providers, facilitates booking administration,
communicates booking terms, supports trust and safety standards, and collects client
payments for bookings made through the platform. For those limited purposes, the
nanny appoints VacayNanny as the nanny's disclosed and limited agent to receive client
payments, deduct the commission and any other lawful, expressly disclosed amounts,
and remit the nanny's net payout in accordance with this Agreement. This authority does
not permit VacayNanny to enter unrelated contracts on the nanny's behalf or to make
commitments outside the marketplace services.

Each accepted booking is a separate engagement for the services described in its booking
confirmation. The nanny decides whether she has the availability, competence and
resources to accept it and must not accept work she cannot safely perform. The nanny
may set and update her availability, accept or decline individual offers, and provide
services independently outside VacayNanny, provided she honours accepted bookings,
protects confidential information and does not divert or privately continue a booking
introduced and confirmed through VacayNanny in breach of the applicable booking
terms. VacayNanny does not require the nanny to remain available when no booking has
been accepted and does not promise a minimum number of bookings, hours or income.

The parties intend this to be a marketplace participation arrangement, not a contract of
employment. However, legal status depends on the actual facts and applicable Kenyan
law, not the label used here. Nothing in this Agreement removes a non-waivable
statutory right or obligation. If the actual arrangement is legally an employment
relationship, the applicable employment law requirements prevail.

VacayNanny does not direct the nanny's day-to-day childcare methods beyond the
agreed care plan, lawful parent/guardian instructions, booking requirements and
safeguarding standards. The nanny remains responsible for deciding how to perform
accepted services safely and professionally, within the agreed scope and applicable law.
The parties will conduct themselves consistently with this stated marketplace
arrangement; the actual legal classification remains subject to the facts and applicable
law.

The nanny must follow parent/guardian instructions only where safe and lawful. If an
instruction appears unsafe, abusive or unlawful, she must not follow it and must
promptly raise the concern.


2. CHILD SAFEGUARDING: NON-NEGOTIABLE RULES

The safety, dignity, wellbeing and best interests of every child are paramount.
VacayNanny has zero tolerance for abuse, exploitation, neglect, intimidation or
deliberate endangerment.

Strictly prohibited conduct includes:

   •   Hitting, slapping, shaking, pinching, pushing, kicking, corporal punishment or
       restraining a child as punishment.

   •   Threatening, humiliating, insulting, shaming, frightening or deliberately isolating
       a child as punishment.

   •   Sexual contact or behaviour, inappropriate touching, grooming, exploitation,
       sexualised communication or exposing a child to sexual material.

   •   Leaving a child alone or unsupervised where care is required, including near
       water, roads, balconies, vehicles or unfamiliar people.

   •   Handing a child to an unauthorised person without express parent/guardian
       approval.

   •   Being under the influence of alcohol, illegal drugs or any substance that impairs
       safe care while responsible for a child.

   •   Taking, storing, posting or sharing a child's photograph, video, location, school
       details or personal information without required informed permission.

Respect each child's privacy and bodily autonomy. Explain care activities in an age-
appropriate way, seek cooperation where possible, use respectful language and maintain
professional boundaries.

3. SAFE DAILY CARE

   •   Follow the agreed care plan, routines, dietary instructions, allergies, emergency
       contacts and special-needs information. Ask for clarification before care begins if
       instructions are incomplete.

   •   Never force-feed or withhold food or water as punishment. Do not give food
       identified as unsafe or known to trigger an allergy.

   •   Give medication only with clear parent/guardian authorisation and reliable
       instructions. Confirm medicine, dose and timing, record administration and
       report errors immediately. Do not diagnose, prescribe, alter doses or perform
       clinical procedures beyond your training and lawful scope.

   •   Keep children away from hazardous substances, sharp objects, open flames,
       unsafe appliances, balconies, pools and traffic. Maintain active supervision
       appropriate to the child's age and needs.

   •   Follow age-appropriate safe-sleep practices and the agreed care instructions.
       Escalate uncertainty to the parent/guardian.

   •   Do not transport a child, leave agreed premises or change destination without
       prior authorisation. Use legally required child restraints and safe transport
       arrangements.

   •   For swimming or water activities, maintain active, close supervision. Flotation
       devices are never a substitute for supervision. Do not take a child into water
       unless authorised and competent to supervise safely.

   •   Do not undertake specialist, medical or nursing tasks unless specifically qualified,
       authorised and legally permitted to do so.


4. OUTINGS, SAFARI AND TRAVEL

Before an outing or journey, confirm destination, route, transport arrangements,
supervising adults, emergency contacts, permissions and expected return time. Keep the
child within the agreed safe area and maintain supervision.

On safari or around wildlife, follow guide and venue safety instructions; keep children in
designated safe areas and never allow them to approach, feed, touch or provoke wildlife.
Do not leave a child unattended in a vehicle or at a venue.

Report delays, route changes, accidents, illness, lost contact or separation immediately.
Do not accept an unapproved change to the itinerary, overnight location or supervising
adult.


5. PROFESSIONAL CONDUCT AND COMMUNICATION

   •     Be punctual, courteous, calm, patient and respectful. Follow confirmed booking
         details and communicate promptly if delayed, unwell or unable to attend.

   •     Keep communication professional. Never encourage a child to keep secrets from
         parents/guardians or use private messaging to develop an inappropriate
         relationship with a child.

   •     Do not invite visitors, bring unauthorised persons to a booking or use family
         property for personal purposes.

   •     Do not smoke, vape, consume alcohol or use illegal drugs while on duty or around
         children.

   •     Do not solicit unauthorised payments, alter agreed prices or arrange off-
         platform/private bookings to circumvent a confirmed VacayNanny booking or its
         terms.

   •     Protect family information, travel plans, accommodation details, access codes and
         personal data.


6. DRESS AND PERSONAL PRESENTATION

Arrive clean, neat and appropriately dressed for active childcare and the specific setting.
Clothing must be modest, comfortable, secure, weather-appropriate and suitable for
bending, lifting, playing, assisting a child and responding quickly to safety concerns. It
must not restrict movement or create a snagging, tripping or injury risk.

•   Wear clean, tidy clothing that is practical, modest and appropriate to the family's
       agreed setting. Avoid excessively revealing, transparent or offensive clothing,
       slogans or images.

   •   Wear secure, comfortable footwear suitable for active supervision. Avoid high
       heels, slippery soles or footwear that prevents quick movement.

   •   Keep hair and accessories secured where needed. Avoid dangling jewellery, sharp
       accessories, long loose scarves or items a child could pull or that could become a
       hazard.

   •   Maintain good personal hygiene and keep nails and accessories suitable for safe
       childcare, including infant care.

Beach and pool settings: Wear modest, practical clothing suitable for active supervision,
such as a comfortable top with suitable shorts or other secure attire, and footwear safe
on wet surfaces. If entering the water is part of the agreed care, use appropriate
swimwear with a suitable cover-up when out of the water. Clothing must allow quick
movement and safe supervision.

Safari and outdoor settings: Wear practical, weather-appropriate clothing, such as
comfortable trousers or suitable shorts, a breathable top, sun protection and sturdy
closed-toe footwear where terrain requires it. Avoid loose or dangling items and
footwear unsuitable for uneven ground. Follow guide or venue safety directions.

Hotels, restaurants and formal venues: Wear neat smart-casual clothing that is modest
and appropriate to the venue while remaining practical for childcare.

Overnight bookings: wear clean, modest and comfortable clothing suitable for agreed
duties and the accommodation setting; remain appropriately dressed whenever
supervising or attending to a child.

The standard is professional and practical, not expensive clothing or a particular body
type, hairstyle, religion or cultural identity. VacayNanny does not require or supply
branded merchandise or uniforms.


7. INCIDENTS, DISCLOSURES AND EMERGENCIES

If a child is injured, seriously unwell, missing, discloses abuse or may be at immediate
risk, the nanny must act promptly:

1. Make the child safe first. Provide immediate assistance within your competence.
      For an urgent emergency, seek medical help and call Kenya's emergency numbers
      999 or 112. Do not delay urgent care while trying to reach VacayNanny or waiting
      for approval.

   2. Notify the parent/guardian and VacayNanny as soon as safe, using the booking
      emergency contacts and reporting channel. If the parent/guardian cannot be
      reached and the child remains at risk, escalate to the appropriate emergency or
      child-protection authority.

   3. For suspected abuse, prioritise immediate safety. The National Child Helpline 116
      is free and operates 24 hours. Report to relevant child-protection or law-
      enforcement authorities where required or where a child may be at risk. Internal
      reporting does not replace reporting to authorities.

   4. Record facts accurately as soon as practicable: date, time, location, people present,
      what was observed or said, the child's exact words where relevant, action taken,
      medical assistance sought and people notified. Submit VacayNanny's incident
      report as soon as practicable and, where safe and feasible, within 24 hours.

   5. Do not investigate, confront an alleged abuser, coach the child, ask leading
      questions, promise secrecy or share details unnecessarily. Preserve relevant
      messages and records.

Never conceal an incident, discourage a child from speaking, retaliate against someone
raising a concern, alter records or delete relevant messages. Urgent medical care and
lawful reporting must never be delayed by internal approval.


  KENYA EMERGENCY CONTACTS: Police / emergency response – 999 or 112.
  National Child Helpline – 116 (free, 24-hour child-protection support). Also use the
  booking-specific parent/guardian and VacayNanny emergency contacts.



8. CONFIDENTIALITY, PHOTOGRAPHS AND PERSONAL DATA

Information about children and families is confidential. Use it only to provide agreed
care, complete the booking and communicate with authorised people. Do not publish,
copy, forward or disclose images, videos, names, medical information, school details,

travel plans, accommodation details, access codes or contact information without
required explicit permission and a lawful basis.

Keep documents and devices secure. Use reasonable safeguards such as device locks,
secure passwords and restricted access. Do not store family or child information longer
than necessary, or transfer it to personal accounts or unauthorised applications. Do not
leave a child alone while using a phone for personal browsing or social media.

Promptly notify VacayNanny if personal information is lost, accessed by an unauthorised
person, sent to the wrong recipient or otherwise compromised. Personal data must be
handled in accordance with the Data Protection Act, 2019 and applicable regulations. The
nanny must cooperate with reasonable requests concerning access, correction, deletion
or protection of personal data.


9. ATTENDANCE, BOOKINGS AND HANDOVERS

   •   Accept only bookings you are qualified, available and fit to perform. Review the
       child's age, care needs, location, dates, hours, duties, additional services and
       payout before accepting.

   •   A booking is confirmed only through VacayNanny's booking process and
       confirmation. Do not rely on an informal discussion to change the agreed scope,
       timing or price.

   •   If delayed, unwell or unable to attend, notify VacayNanny and the
       parent/guardian promptly. Do not arrange an unapproved substitute.

   •   At the start of care, confirm parent/guardian instructions, emergency contacts,
       authorised collection persons, allergies, medication and any special care plan.

   •   At handover, share relevant information about meals, sleep, activities,
       medication, incidents and the child's wellbeing. Complete the required booking
       completion form.

   •   Release the child only to the parent/guardian or a person expressly authorised by
       them. If uncertain, contact the parent/guardian before release.

   •   Do not extend hours, add overnight care, change location or undertake additional
       duties without agreement through the booking process.

•   Cancellations, changes, late arrival, non-attendance and early termination of a
       booking are governed by the Booking, Cancellation and Refund Policy and the
       terms shown to the family and nanny before confirmation. The nanny must
       review those terms before accepting a booking. Any approved extension,
       additional hours, overnight care, extra day or change of location must be
       recorded through VacayNanny's booking process before the additional service is
       performed, except where immediate action is reasonably necessary to protect a
       child.

   •   If a family is unavailable at the agreed location or does not present the child for
       care, the nanny must promptly contact VacayNanny and follow the booking
       support instructions. The nanny must not leave a child in unsafe circumstances or
       abandon an active handover. Where a booking ends early, payment for services
       actually provided and any applicable cancellation amount will be determined
       under the disclosed booking terms, subject to applicable law.


10. TIERS, PLATFORM COMMISSION AND NANNY PAYOUTS

The nanny's approved tier determines the platform commission percentage and
corresponding nanny payout. The percentages below apply to the total agreed nanny
service value for each booking.


                                  VACAYNANNY
 APPROVED TIER                                                    NANNY PAYOUT
                                  COMMISSION

 BRONZE                           22.73%                          77.27%

 SILVER                           21.88%                          78.12%

 GOLD                             21.15%                          78.85%



Calculation basis: The applicable tier percentage is applied to the total agreed nanny
service charges, including the standard service fee and agreed paid additions or
supplements such as overnight care, additional hours, extra days, specialist-care
supplements or other approved childcare services. Where a booking is extended or
amended, the same tier percentage applies to the revised total service value.

Taxes collected for remittance and separately itemised, pre-approved pass-through
expenses reimbursed at cost are excluded from the commission base unless the booking
confirmation expressly states otherwise and the treatment is lawful. No undisclosed fee
or deduction may be applied. The nanny authorises VacayNanny to collect the booking
payment from the client, deduct the applicable disclosed tier commission and any legally
required withholding or expressly approved adjustment, and remit the balance to the
verified payment details on file. VacayNanny will maintain booking and payout records
and make relevant statements or transaction details available through the platform or
support channel. Where the nanny is legally responsible for her own tax obligations, she
remains responsible for declaring income and meeting those obligations; this does not
prevent VacayNanny from making deductions or reporting required by law.

Payout procedure:

   1. At the end of the booking or agreed booking contract, the nanny must complete
       and submit the VacayNanny Booking Completion and Payout Form.

   2. The parent/guardian or authorised client must review the completed service and
       sign off the booking. The sign-off confirms booking dates, hours, agreed additional
       services and completion status; it does not waive the right to raise a genuine
       complaint or safeguarding concern.

   3. Once the completed form and client sign-off have been received and checked,
       VacayNanny will process the nanny's payout to the verified payment details on
       file within three (3) business days, subject to a genuine, documented dispute or
       legal restriction.

   4. If the client does not respond to a sign-off request within 48 hours after receiving
       it, VacayNanny may review the booking record, communications and other
       available evidence and determine whether the booking can be treated as
       completed. Silence alone will not automatically cancel a nanny's legitimate
       entitlement for services actually provided.

   5. If only part of a booking is genuinely disputed, VacayNanny will review the
       disputed portion and will not unreasonably delay payment of an undisputed
       amount.

False information, forged signatures or falsified completion records: The nanny
must never sign on behalf of a parent/client, imitate a signature, alter a sign-off, fabricate

hours or submit a false completion or payout form. Where there is credible evidence of
forgery or fraud, VacayNanny may suspend the affected payout to the extent reasonably
necessary while it investigates, request supporting evidence, reject a fraudulent or
unperformed booking claim, suspend marketplace access and refer suspected forgery or
fraud to relevant authorities. Proven fraud may result in non-payment for the fraudulent
or unperformed portion, recovery of amounts already paid where lawful, and civil or
criminal legal action. This clause does not authorise unlawful forfeiture of payment for
genuine services properly performed.

Cancellations, refunds, chargebacks, tips and approved expenses will be handled under
booking terms disclosed to the nanny and client before confirmation. Any payout
adjustment must be explained and supported by the booking record. The nanny must
keep payment details accurate and promptly report any change.

A refund, reversal or chargeback will be assessed against the booking record and
applicable booking terms. VacayNanny may temporarily hold only the amount
reasonably connected to a genuine, documented dispute, chargeback or legal restriction
and will communicate the reason to the nanny where lawful. Any amount not genuinely
disputed must not be unreasonably withheld. VacayNanny will not impose an
undisclosed penalty or make a deduction unsupported by the booking terms or
applicable law.


11. VERIFICATION, LISTING AND CONTINUED ELIGIBILITY

Participation and continued access to the marketplace are conditional on VacayNanny
completing proportionate identity, qualification, reference and safeguarding checks,
receiving this signed Agreement and confirming activation.

For the stated onboarding and safeguarding purposes, and subject to applicable data-
protection law, the nanny authorises VacayNanny to:

   •   Check identity against the original National Identity Card, passport or other
       accepted identity document and confirm that details match the application.

   •   Require a current Police Clearance Certificate (Certificate of Good Conduct) and,
       where appropriate, verify it through the official DCI verification process or
       another lawful official channel.

•   Where the nanny has applied but is awaiting the certificate, accept DCI Form C24
       and the payment invoice/receipt only as evidence that an application is in
       progress. C24 is not a Police Clearance Certificate and is not clearance. The profile
       remains pending and must not be activated for client assignments until the actual
       certificate is received and reviewed.

   •   Verify education, childcare, first-aid, paediatric first-aid, specialist-care and other
       claimed qualifications with the issuing institution or certification body where
       reasonably practicable.

   •   Contact supplied references and make proportionate enquiries about relevant
       childcare experience, reliability, professional conduct and suitability.

   •   Review right-to-work, immigration or other authorisation documents where
       relevant to the proposed service and applicable law.

VacayNanny may request clarification, updated documents or additional checks where
reasonably necessary, relevant and lawful. The nanny must promptly disclose any
material change affecting suitability, eligibility, ability to provide safe care or profile
accuracy.

Verification is not a guarantee that a person will never pose a risk. A Police Clearance
Certificate reflects information available to the issuing authority as at its date of issue.
VacayNanny may assess adverse or inconsistent information fairly, give the nanny an
opportunity to explain where appropriate, and take proportionate action to protect
children and families.

Personal information and verification records will be collected, used, accessed, retained
and securely disposed of in accordance with the Data Protection Act, 2019 and applicable
regulations. Access will be limited to authorised persons and information retained only
as long as reasonably necessary for the stated purposes or as required by law.


12. BREACHES, SAFEGUARDING ACTION AND CONSEQUENCES

To protect children and families, VacayNanny may take proportionate protective action
where a concern is raised or a requirement is not met. Depending on circumstances and
applicable law, this may include temporarily suspending new booking offers or access
while a concern is assessed; requesting an explanation or records; requiring additional

training or corrective action for lower-level matters; restricting or removing a profile;
notifying affected families where necessary and lawful; or referring suspected criminal
conduct and child-protection concerns to relevant authorities.

Serious misconduct, including abuse, sexual misconduct, deliberate neglect,
abandonment, exploitation, falsification of identity or verification documents, forged
booking sign-offs, retaliation or concealment of an incident, may result in immediate
protective suspension and, following appropriate assessment, permanent removal from
the marketplace.

VacayNanny's platform action is separate from criminal, civil, employment or regulatory
processes. Only a court or competent authority determines criminal guilt and imposes
criminal penalties. The nanny may raise a concern or provide an explanation through
the contact route stated in booking or onboarding information.

Performance feedback and tier assessment: VacayNanny may consider verified client
feedback, punctuality, booking completion, reliability, safeguarding compliance,
complaints and relevant service-quality information when reviewing a nanny's
continued eligibility or tier. Tier changes must be based on disclosed, relevant criteria
and communicated to the nanny. A nanny may request an explanation or review of a tier
decision and provide relevant information. A rating or complaint will not, by itself, be
treated as conclusive proof of misconduct.

Review and appeal: Except where immediate protective action is reasonably necessary to
safeguard a child, VacayNanny will, where practicable, notify the nanny of the material
concern and provide a reasonable opportunity to respond before making a final decision
that materially restricts marketplace participation. A nanny may request a review
through the contact route provided in onboarding or the platform, ordinarily within
fourteen (14) days of the decision. VacayNanny will consider relevant information and
communicate its decision within a reasonable period. An appeal does not automatically
suspend an urgent safeguarding measure or prevent a report to an authority.

Suspension and termination: Either party may end marketplace participation by giving
written notice through the designated contact channel. VacayNanny may suspend access
immediately where reasonably necessary to protect a child, prevent fraud, comply with
law or address a serious safety concern. For other material breaches, VacayNanny may
give notice of the concern and a reasonable opportunity to remedy it where appropriate.

Ending participation does not cancel obligations relating to an already accepted booking
unless the parties agree otherwise or safety or law requires cancellation. Earned and
undisputed payouts remain payable, subject to this Agreement and applicable law.
Confidentiality, data protection, payment reconciliation and provisions which by their
nature should continue will survive termination.

Changes to this Agreement: VacayNanny may update this Agreement by giving the nanny
notice of the revised terms and their effective date. A material change to commission,
payout calculations or other commercial terms will be communicated before it applies to
a new booking, and the nanny may decline new bookings or end participation if she does
not agree. No change will retrospectively alter the commercial terms of a booking
already confirmed, except where required by law or agreed by the parties.

Insurance, loss and responsibility: The nanny must take reasonable care of children,
family property and any equipment entrusted to her, and must promptly report any
injury, loss or damage. The nanny must not admit liability, promise compensation or
settle a claim on behalf of VacayNanny or a family. Each party remains responsible for
its own acts and omissions to the extent provided by applicable law. Any insurance
requirement applicable to a particular booking or service must be disclosed before the
nanny accepts that booking. Nothing in this Agreement excludes or limits liability which
cannot lawfully be excluded or limits a party's responsibility for its own negligence,
fraud, wilful misconduct or breach of statutory duty.


13. KENYAN CHILD-PROTECTION AND OTHER APPLICABLE LAW

This Agreement supports compliance with applicable Kenyan law, including the Children
Act, 2022 (Act No. 29 of 2022). Section 22 prohibits subjecting a child to psychological
abuse or child abuse. A person who contravenes section 22(1) commits an offence and,
on conviction, is liable to imprisonment for a term not exceeding five years, a fine not
exceeding KES 2,000,000, or both. Other conduct, including sexual offences, assault,
neglect or exploitation, may attract different offences and penalties under other laws.

The nanny must comply with all applicable child-protection, criminal, privacy, transport,
health and safety laws. This summary is not a complete statement of the law and does
not replace legal advice.

14. ACKNOWLEDGEMENT AND UNDERTAKING

By signing this Agreement, I confirm that:

   •    I have read and understood this Agreement, including the commercial terms
        applicable to my approved tier, or it has been explained to me in a language I
        understand.

   •    The information and documents I supplied are accurate and genuine to the best of
        my knowledge.

   •    The safety, dignity, wellbeing and best interests of every child come first, and I
        agree to comply with the safeguarding and conduct requirements.

   •    I understand the marketplace participation model, the commission applicable to
        my tier, the payout process and the requirement for a completed booking form
        and client sign-off.

   •    I will not forge, imitate or submit a false client signature or completion record.

   •    My profile will not be published, activated or made available for client
        assignments until required checks are complete, this Agreement is signed and
        accepted, and VacayNanny confirms activation in writing.

   •    I have had an opportunity to ask questions, request an explanation and retain a
        copy of this Agreement.

   •    I understand that booking-specific prices, cancellation and refund terms,
        additional services and any applicable client charges will be disclosed through the
        platform or booking confirmation before I accept the booking.
